themes.title: Confidence
themes.summary: God finishes the good work he begins in us.

themes.title: Partnership
themes.summary: Paul's joy comes from friends who share the work of the gospel with him.

themes.title: Purpose
themes.summary: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

questions.prompt: What "good work" do you hope God is finishing in you?
Paul turns prison into an opportunity. What hard situation could become one for you?
Who is a partner in your faith you could thank this week?

themes.title: Humility
themes.summary: Count others more significant than yourself, and look to their interests too.

themes.title: The mind of Christ
themes.summary: Jesus emptied himself and became a servant; let that mind be in you.

themes.title: Shining
themes.summary: Without murmuring, shine as lights in the world.

questions.prompt: Whose interests could you look out for this week?
Where is it hardest for you to do things "without murmurings and disputings"?
What would one small act of serving look like tomorrow?

themes.title: Knowing Christ
themes.summary: Paul counts everything else as loss next to knowing Jesus.

themes.title: Pressing on
themes.summary: Forget what is behind and reach toward what is ahead.

themes.title: True citizenship
themes.summary: Our citizenship is in heaven, and that changes how we live now.

questions.prompt: What is one thing behind you that you need to stop carrying?
What would "pressing toward the mark" look like for you this week?

themes.title: Joy
themes.summary: Rejoice in the Lord always, and again, rejoice.

themes.title: Peace over anxiety
themes.summary: Turn worry into prayer, and the peace of God will keep your heart and mind.

themes.title: Contentment
themes.summary: Paul has learned to be content whether he has much or little.

questions.prompt: What is one worry you can turn into a prayer right now?
Verse 8 lists what to "think on." Which one does your scrolling feed need most?
Where are you learning contentment — or still struggling to?
